Adaptations in this build include standing, walking, sitting and dining poses, baked game meshes, and optimized textures and materials. The student guest also has an original citrus screen print, ribbed trim, remeshed cloth folds and additional painted detail on the face, irises and hair.
The eleven additional guests and the owner use adapted facial geometry, texture elements
and expression shapes derived from the two models above. The ungloved resting hand form
is derived from VRM1_Constraint_Twist_Sample. The footwear for those diners uses adapted
shoe meshes and UVs from both samples with recoloured and repainted shoe textures. These adaptations retain their sources'
rights and usage conditions. Character styling, clothing, hair and occupational props
for the additional diners, the food, game logic, set and user interface were made for Burger Club.
